notes: Two sources only, both ESPEC North America: the 2-page ADBC-T flyer (research/v5/cache/0adc2434242b8421.raw, an image-only PDF read visually; its .txt is empty) and the Battery Test Systems family page (research/v5/cache/ba9022fb6a6fdaa3.txt), which repeats the flyer spec table verbatim; quotes are taken from the family-page text where available. Flyer-only numbers: Weight Approx. 1,455 lbs (660 kg); Floor load capacity of the chamber (Equally distributed load) 88 lbs (40 kg). Geometry for the 3D model: a single 1200 W x 1300 D x 2022 H mm floor-standing box; three equal 510 x 400 x 400 mm zones stacked vertically behind three slate-blue front doors with screw-in lock knobs; a shorter blue panel below them fronting the refrigeration/machinery bay (flyer photo shows a finned condenser unit at the base and louvred side/top vents); a full-height black control column on the right with three zone controllers (one per zone), status lamps and a red emergency-stop button. Each zone rear wall carries a grid of round cable ports (flyer photo) for the user-supplied charge/discharge power supply; the ADBC-T itself has no instrumentation lines, so wiring kind is 'none'. Horizontal laminar airflow per zone (blower/plenum behind the rear wall; no CFM published). Cooling: 'Independent control of three chambers' plus a 'Water-cooled refrigeration system' option and the condenser unit in the flyer photo establish a mechanical refrigeration system; the standard condenser type, compressor count and refrigerant are not published (catalog flags cryogen fields unknown). No window is listed as standard or option; no vacuum, no magnet. Options not fitted in this configuration: pressure relief vent, gas detector, CO2 fire extinguisher, impedance measurement function, custom battery mounting boards, water-cooled refrigeration. Tavily quota was exhausted; WebSearch found no additional ADBC-T spec source (ESPEC NA has no separate ADBC-T model page).
